title: Minecraft Durability Sensor Misc
description: Enables an item to emit effects when it receives damage. Because of this, the item also needs a `minecraft:durability` component.

durability_thresholds.title: Durability Thresholds
durability_thresholds.description:
The list of both durability thresholds and effects emitted when each threshold is met. When multiple thresholds are met, only the threshold with the lowest durability after applying the damage is considered.

Properties:
• durability (int)
• particle_type (string)
• sound_event (string)

defaultSnippets.label: Minecraft Durability Sensor Durability Threshold Misc
defaultSnippets.description: Defines both the durability threshold, and the effects emitted when that threshold is met.

misc_minecraft_durability_sensor_durabil.title: Minecraft Durability Sensor Durability Threshold Misc
misc_minecraft_durability_sensor_durabil.description: Defines both the durability threshold, and the effects emitted when that threshold is met.

durability.title: Durability
durability.description: The effects are emitted when the item durability value is less than or equal to this value.

particle_type.title: ParticleType
particle_type.description: Particle effect to emit when the threshold is met.

sound_event.title: LevelSoundEvent
sound_event.description: Sound effect to emit when the threshold is met.
